lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five to six horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration along the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, with high-intensity blobs situated at the approximate centers of the resulting grid cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with higher pixel values on the dorsal aspect and lower pixel values/shadow on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three discrete marks or pale lesions are visible on the lateral flank superior to the pectoral fin insertion point; a thin, white, filament-like appendage or tag is visible trailing from the distal tip of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Three artificial white arrows are superimposed on the pixel data, pointing toward the junction of the lateral flank and the pectoral fin.
